name: Playgama Developer Cabinet
description: Publishes and manages HTML5 games on Playgama from a coding agent: creates a game and fills in its form, uploads builds and covers, edits the in-app purchase catalog and leaderboards, returns a QA Tool link, and publishes a sandbox - a public link anyone can play with no moderation step. 22 tools, 11 of them read-only; submitting to moderation, deleting and payouts stay human actions in the cabinet.
author: Playgama
